Company Wiki

Every document that has no other home in ERPNext — reconciliations, contracts, COAs, holds, statements and onboarding — in one flow, top to bottom.

…records tracked
1 One-Time Setup Masters you configure once
🏢
Business Entity
…
The client companies — TSBC Ranch, Motley Terpz, Master Touch Manufacturing, LA Canna. Every record links to one; User Permissions scope who sees what.
Open list →
2 Client Intake The day paperwork arrives
📋
Onboarding Packet
…
New-client compliance packet. A 7-document checklist seeds itself — tick items as they arrive, attach each file on its row.
Open list →
3 Agreements & Commitments Paper the relationship
📝
Company Contract
…
Client, vendor & staffing contracts with payment terms and expiry. A Director activates via the workflow button.
Open list →
🤝

…
Quantity holds and commitments. Close them out as Fulfilled or Expired before they age past 90 days.
Open list →
👷

1099 contractors — rate, rate type, term and the signed agreement.
Open list →
⚗️

Tolling deals with partners. Log each run in the child table; actual yield % computes automatically.
Open list →
4 Ongoing Operations The daily & weekly grind
⚖️
Reconciliation Record
…
10–15/day via Quick Entry: type, entity, period end, two balances — variance computes itself. Review → Approve → Lock.
Open list →

Lab results per batch with the report PDF attached. Fail or Pending results hit the watchlist below.
Open list →

Weekly/monthly statements — last 4 digits only, full account numbers are rejected. Links to its reconciliation.
Open list →

Catch-all for SOPs, correspondence and one-offs. Tag records so they stay findable.

★ Watchlists Review these weekly, top to bottom
💰
Open Variance Report
Report
Unlocked reconciliations aged by period end — unexplained variances in red.
Run report →
⏳
Active Holds by Age
Report
Open LOIs sorted oldest first; anything held past 90 days is flagged.
Run report →
📅
Contract and Agreement Expiry
Report
Contracts & tolling deals expiring soon, bucketed 30 / 60 / 90 days.
Run report →
🚨
COA Exceptions
Report
Every Failed or Pending lab result, grouped by product category.
Run report →
🧾
Onboarding Completion
Report
Stuck packets with exactly which required documents are still missing.
Run report →
How it all works
🏢Setup & access control›
Business Entity is the anchor master. To restrict a user to one company, create a User Permission (Allow = Business Entity, For Value = the entity) with Apply to all document types checked — every doctype here has a business_entity field, so the restriction cascades everywhere automatically. Assign the four roles — Accounting Team, Operations, ERP Dev Team, Director — to control who can create, edit, approve and delete.
📋Onboarding a client›
Create an Onboarding Packet when paperwork arrives (use Prospective Client Name if they aren't a Customer yet). The checklist — license, seller's permit, resale cert, W-9, insurance, voided check, signed contract — seeds itself. Mark rows received, attach files on each row, set status Complete when done. Incomplete packets appear in the Onboarding Completion watchlist with the missing documents named.
📝Contracts & the workflow buttons›
Contract and Reconciliation statuses are workflow-controlled: you move them with the action button in the form's top-right (Activate, Submit for Review, Approve, Lock…), never by editing the status field. Transitions are role-restricted — e.g. only a Director can Approve a reconciliation or Activate a contract — and every change is captured in the audit trail.
⚖️Daily reconciliations›
From the Reconciliation Record list, hit + Add: Quick Entry asks for just five fields and the variance computes itself. Add line items and the explanation later, then Submit for Review. The system refuses to Approve a non-zero variance without an explanation. Lock at month-end — locked records drop off the Open Variance watchlist.
📎Attachments›
Each doctype has one primary Attach field for the signed document or lab report. Everything else — email trails, extra scans, revisions — goes in the record's sidebar Attachments, which accepts unlimited files on every record.
📈The weekly review›
Scan the five watchlists top to bottom: open variances, aging holds, upcoming expiries, COA exceptions, stuck onboardings. Every report filters by Business Entity plus its own filters — date ranges, minimum age, type — and rows link straight to the record.
